reviews.title: Ads and bugs
reviews.text:
I only use it on Apple TV. They did not mess with the video player UI, which if you used Now TV you know the pain, on downside the pause button on the remote doesn’t work but clicking the middle of the remote trackpad does so.. But they do not joke around, it’s ads after ads, so many ads, specially American programs which have so many ad breaks, if you just want to scrub through to the end of a show, you need to see the ads. And it has so many bugs, it’s impossible to scrub through a video, the video Ui just fades away, tapping the edges of the remote for quick 10s skip doesn’t work either. You start seeing a show say s01e01, it then sets the next one to a newer season like s03e02 On that note often doesn’t mark an episode as watched, you have to use the Apple TV app to do that instead, thank god for that integration as browsing a tv show in Apple TV app is more efficient Sometimes just image just goes black, you then have to go back in and you know see ads again Often at the end of a show the image gets smaller to show the next episode way before the show actually reached the end, you then have to maximise it again AND hit play But you know it’s free so..

One more thing: the ad breaks are constantly changing, sometimes they are 3 minutes, sometimes just 30s or even 15, so by time you get up to go the toilet it’s already over, I prefer consistency to be able to enjoy my breaks.

2026 update: on Apple TV app, after the ad breaks the ui is unresponsive and you can’t pause what

reviews.title: Far too glitchy
reviews.text: I accept that ad breaks are part of the deal - that’s not a problem for me: But the app is far too glitchy with them which really detracts from the experience. It regularly glitches after an ad break during a show - the screen goes black and the captions for the show continue on but nothing else. Then the only way to fix it is to stop and restart the show - and then watch another round of ads. By the time I’ve had to do that a couple of times during the same episode, I’m really regretting ever choosing to watch a Channel 4 show. That needs to be resolved for me to want to use this app.

reviews.title: Pretty much unwatchable

A great shame. I appreciate ad revenue is needed for quality content but why so many ads in each break?

UPDATE
It’s still completely USELESS. Either it doesn’t recognise your internet connection or your login details. Login reset achieves absolutely naff all. UPDATE FRAUD ALERT: although it’s finally working properly I signed up to the introductory offer for Ad Free TV.  Basically my money was STOLEN. Having paid, it’s gone out of my bank, I still have adverts. DON’T SIGN UP FOR AD FREE, IT’S A SCAM. Cancelling subscription forthwith
